SEARCH
Package domain

Class Ball

java.lang.Object
domain.Entity
domain.Ball
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Ball extends Entity
The real ball of a match. Gravity, rebounds and hits are computed by the physics library. After a power shot the ball carries that shot: if it touches the rival, the rival gets its damage and effect.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

  • Constructor Details

    • Ball

      public Ball(double x, double y, double radius, BallSkin skin)
      Creates a still ball with no charge.
      Parameters:
      x - left edge of its box, in pixels
      y - top edge of its box, in pixels
      radius - radius, in pixels; the box is 2 * radius wide and high
      skin - ball chosen by the player, only used to draw it

  • Method Details

    • applyImpulse

      public void applyImpulse(double ix, double iy)
      Kicks the ball: it leaves with this velocity, whatever it had before.
      Parameters:
      ix - horizontal velocity of the kick, in pixels per second
      iy - vertical velocity of the kick, in pixels per second (negative goes up)

    • launchPowerShot

      public void launchPowerShot(PowerShot shot, String shooter, double vx, double vy)
      Launches a power shot: the ball leaves with this velocity and carries the shot.
      Parameters:
      shot - the power shot
      shooter - "LEFT" or "RIGHT": side of the player who shot
      vx - horizontal velocity, in pixels per second
      vy - vertical velocity, in pixels per second
